title: A told plan dependency (depends-told.jsonl)
description: One line of the farmer's keyed log of told plan dependencies (hal2 plan 0595 step 11; the farmer skill's scripts/lead_depends.py record): the farmer's foreman round told the field of a dependent plan that the plan it waited for reached its `until`. The last line per `key` is the state; an edge is told once.

at.description: When it was told, RFC 3339 UTC with Z and whole seconds.

slot.description: The dependent plan's field (worktree) that was told.

state.description: The dependency's state when told: pushed, hitched or main.

until.description: What the edge waits for: pushed or main.
